mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.25%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in the demand for goods and services, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS above 140 million) indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is above 140 million, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.0%, it signals a potential for monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) indicates a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate hiring, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction (HOUST) falls below 1000.0 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1000.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
